fullDescription: A high-tech, premium dark-mode design system tailored for Discord bots, SaaS platforms, or developer tools. It features a sophisticated palette of neon accents (#f04444, #14b8a6, #fbbf24) against a deep navy background (#0f172a). The aesthetic combines glassmorphism, editorial typography with 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'Satoshi', and scroll-triggered spring animations. Key features include animated mesh backgrounds, bento-style feature grids, and interactive simulation components like terminal logs and UI previews.
prompt:
## Resumo
A futuristic dark-theme design system featuring glassmorphic navigation, high-contrast accent colors, and editorial-scale typography. It uses smooth spring-based entrance animations and floating decorative elements to create a sense of 'elite' software quality.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system using a dark background #0f172a. Colors: Primary #f04444, Teal #14b8a6, Gold #fbbf24, Purple #a855f7, Blue #3b82f6. Typography: Headings in 'Cabinet Grotesk' (weights 800, 700), body in 'Satoshi'. Headers should have letter-spacing: -0.02em and line-height: 1.2. Use lowercase or uppercase tracking-widest for metadata labels. UI elements should have 2xl to 4rem border-radius. Borders should be white/5 or white/10. Animations: 20s mesh gradient flow (radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, rgba(240, 68, 68, 0.05) 0%, transparent 40%)), 6s floating icons, and spring entrance reveals using cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation Header
Fixed header (h-20) with 90% opacity background #0f172a, backdrop-blur-md, and border-b border-white/5. Left: Logo with a 9x9 bg-primary square and shield icon. Center: Nav links in bold text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-white/40 (hover: white). Right: Two-button CTA area (gap-4): 1. 'Login' button in white/10 glass style, 2. Discord icon button in solid white with dark text #0f172a, px-6 py-3 rounded-full.

### Hero Section
2-column grid. Left: Status badges (pill-shaped, white/5 bg), massive headings (text-8xl), and 2xl-rounded primary CTA. Right: Decorative 3D-effect container with 4rem border-radius, floating icons (shield, message, settings) using keyframe 'float' animations, and a mockup representing internal software functionality.

### Feature Sections
Alternating grid layouts with vertical padding py-32. Each section features a signature color icon (e.g., primary, teal, or gold) in a 16x16 20%-opacity colored background. Include data cards with large 3xl stats and 2xl-rounded containers for interactive simulations like terminal feeds or message previews.

### Interactive Pricing
Three-tier card system. Center 'Architect' card is scaled to 110%, featuring a 1.5px gradient top border (primary to teal) and a bouncing 'Popular' badge. Toggle switch (w-20 h-10) for monthly/yearly billing using a white knob that slides with a shadow glow.

### Global Footer
4-column layout with background #0b1222. Column 1: Large logo and brand description. Column 2-3: Link lists with underline-on-hover effects. Column 4: System trust indicators with live status pulses (teal dot). Bottom bar with copyright and version numbers in uppercase tracking-widest text-white/20.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Live Log Feed Terminal — A scrollable activity feed mimicking a terminal environment.
Create a black/40 container with border-white/10 and 2.5rem border-radius. Header includes a pulsing teal 'Live' dot. Rows consist of color-coded status labels (e.g., BAN, WARN, JOIN) in bold uppercase tracking-widest font, left-bordered with the respective accent color. New entries should animate in from translateY(4) with opacity-0 to opacity-1.

### Interactive Embed Builder — A real-time visual UI editor preview.
Left side: Input fields (bg-white/5, border-white/10) for text and description with color selection squares. Right side: A mock Discord chat bubble (bg-[#313338]) containing a message embed. The embed must have a 4px left-border that changes color dynamically and a 'BOT' badge (bg-[#5865F2]) next to the bot name.

### Glass Login Button — A refined, subtle glassmorphic action button.
bg-white/10, border-white/10, backdrop-blur-sm, px-6 py-3, rounded-full, text-xs bold uppercase tracking-widest white. Hover: bg-white/20, no shadow, smooth 300ms transition.

## Notas Especiais
Must use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for all large headings. Must maintain a strict gap of at least 80px between sections. Never use pure black #000; use #0f172a or #0b1222. Interactive elements must have a springy scale transition on hover (scale-105 or scale-110). Glass effects must include both backdrop-blur and border-white/10 to be visible against the dark background.
